vendor/iife-Editor.js is GENERATED. Do not edit it; run node apps/svg-edit/vendor.mjs.

upstream: https://github.com/SVG-Edit/svgedit
npm:      svgedit@7.4.2
entry:    dist/editor/iife-Editor.js (classic IIFE, window.Editor)
images:   dist/editor/images + jgraduate, inlined as vendor/images.js
store:    gifos.db via boot.js / app.js (noDefaultExtensions, noStorageOnLoad)
extPath:  forced to ./extensions — new URL(relative, about:srcdoc) throws

SVG-Edit is MIT (COPYING.txt). jGraduate / context menu are Apache-2.0
(COPYING-Apache-2.0.txt). The IIFE also bundles i18next, elix, html2canvas,
jsPDF and svg2pdf (MIT). Notices travel inside the GIF.
